summary: 55-year-old Chicago man took a ~900-ft tumbling/sliding fall while backcountry skiing "The Drift" on the east face of Flattop Mountain; rangers hiked in from the Bear Lake trailhead and reached him about an hour later, then descended in whiteout conditions to the trailhead ~6:30 p.m.; ambulanced to Estes Park Medical Center and flown to Medical Center of the Rockies with numerous injuries
location: The Drift, east face of Flattop Mountain, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: Incident date pinned to Wed 2011-01-12: NPS morning report filed Thu Jan 13 says the cell call came "yesterday afternoon". Weekday-verified. Run 491: NPS Jan-12-2011 release URL appended (search-index verified; same 2011-01-12 Sedlack/Flattop 'The Drift' ~900-ft ski fall incident). Run 491: NPS Jan-13-2011 follow-up release URL appended (search-index verified; names Scott Sedlack, 55, Chicago; 11 park staff + 2 park medics, 9 Larimer County SAR on the carryout; flown to Medical Center of the Rockies).
